consent.title: Before we begin
consent.intro: Chronos Place is a space for people living with or beyond chronic health conditions. Your health information is yours — you decide exactly who sees it and when.
consent.healthDescription: If you choose to share health information, it is stored encrypted and is never shared without your explicit permission. You can change or delete it at any time.
consent.marketingDescription: Occasional product updates and community news. You can unsubscribe at any time.
consent.requiredNotice: The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are required to use the app. Health data consent is optional and asked only before your first health question.
